scope: Native C200 with exact BDA/LIB/CLR staging. A controlled 20-unit fixture calls real actionable-unit, movement, command, target, number and strategic-city controllers; markers record returned values only. All choices are native touch input. Also normal main/scenario/ruler session flow and touch/key mixing. No filesystem save or complete campaign/physical-device claim.
limitations: Continuous drag remains unverified on hardware: diagnostic C200/QEMU motion delivered the initial coordinate for down/up and no changing coordinate during hold; MIPS tests cover the SDK gesture path. Native tests verify the edge-tap viewport fallback.

cases.name: Tap an unselected main-menu row activates it once
Tap a player unit selects the real actionable unit
Tap a legal destination opens the production unit command menu
Tap attack menu row enters target selection without confirming a target
Tap an enemy selects the validated original attack target
Touch plus and confirm return the edited number through production code
Tap empty map edge moves strategic viewport and clamps cursor into view
Viewport scrolling does not select a city or activate a command
Physical up key changes the cursor row after touch edge scrolling
Tap a visible city returns the matching original city ID
Tap new game opens scenario menu through normal session code
Tap scenario opens original ruler selector
Tap ruler completes normal new-game selection and displays strategy
